_readme: Every word the film says. Edit the strings, reload, done — no code. Each key is one act. 'caption' is what a screen reader announces when the act begins, and it is also the subtitle printed under the picture: keep it to one or two short sentences that cover what is on screen. Everything else is drawn on the canvas. Act lengths live in src/film/acts/actN.ts; see the comment block at the top of src/film/timeline.ts.
